zh.name: 填空式发言提纲
zh.summary: 按发言顺序提供章节、可替换字段和示例句，帮助读者完成一篇实际发言。
zh.useWhen: 章节顺序及承接是核心；区别于独立问题组成的练习工作表。
zh.instructions: 讲话场合、关系、时长、真实故事与称呼
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Fill-in Speech Outline
en.summary: Create an Instagram reference carousel using the fill-in speech outline structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the fill-in speech outline format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
